title: Oracle3: Paper-Trading Engine and MCP Server for Prediction-Market Arbitrage
description: Oracle3 is an open-source paper-trading engine and Model Context Protocol server for prediction markets. It maps logical relations between event contracts on Kalshi and Polymarket, checks whether quoted prices violate the axioms of probability after each venue's published fees, and paper-trades the baskets that survive under pre-trade risk limits. It includes six constraint-based, two statistical-arbitrage and two model-driven strategies, and a fair-value engine based on the Wang transform calibrated on 291,309 resolved contracts. The original U Lab portions are MIT-licensed; see NOTICE.
